**Feature: Shadow Network.** You have access to the Volstrucker shadow network, which allows you to communicate with other members of the order over long distances. If you write a letter in a special arcane ink, address it to a member of the Volstrucker, and cast it into a fire, the letter will burn to cinders and materialize whole again on the person of the agent you addressed it to.

Creatures marked with an asterisk appear in Boo's Astral Menagerie; the others are described in the Monster Manual.
